name: The Warden encounter
notes: Story bible §4.2 (CANON v1): how the player resolved Brother Horn, the Warden of the Knot. Resolutions combine (trick him, then befriend him in the Fold; befriend him, then help him), so each is its own fact. Whether he lives is horn.fate (endings). Rescues are §4.5: each time Horn drags the defeated player to the Fold.

facts.description: The player beat Horn in combat and he yielded ("Enough. Hear me, or finish it."). Fight & kill and Fight & spare both start here.
Fight & spare: after beating Horn the player listened instead of finishing him. He cannot hold the shaft in Act III until healed.
Trick: the player reached the Fold without him (sneaked past, lured him with a Mirror Self, trapped him behind the portcullis or stole the horn-key).
Befriend (or won the Trial of Horns, which counts as Befriend): Horn is a full ally, shares Hornfolk lore, opens the crypt shortcut and fights at the shaft.
Knight: the player won the Trial of Horns honour duel (first to three clean parries or blocks). Also sets horn.befriended.
Help, after Befriend: the player brought bread for the sleepers, healed Horn and sealed the breach. The best outcome.
Times Horn dragged the defeated player to the Fold (story bible §4.5). Horn remarks on the count.
